results.title: Exact characterization of #P oracle lowness
results.scope: Equality of #P^A and #P on binary words iff A is in UP ∩ coUP. Uses strict polynomial-time adaptive word-oracle verifiers, with resource bounds for arbitrary replies; does not assert an oracle-machine counting characterization.

results.title: GapP and SPP lowness characterize SPP
results.scope: Binary-word instances; strict adaptive oracle-verifier model. GapP is a difference of two unsigned witness counts.

results.title: Fixed first-order queries are decidable in logarithmic space
results.scope: Fixed first-order sentences over finite relational vocabularies, with explicit structure encoding and malformed-input rejection. Includes empty structures and nullary relations; excludes constants and built-in order/BIT from the cited FO convention.

results.title: NL is contained in P
results.scope: Finite-control native nondeterministic multi-tape machines and arbitrary injective encodings. The stronger recognizer result permits nonterminating branches with logarithmic workspace; deterministic polynomial-time configuration reachability decides acceptance.

results.title: PPZ success probability for k-SAT
results.scope: CNF over Fin n, clauses of length at most k ≥ 1. One-round success probability at least 2^(-(1 - 1/k)n); also a unique-solution theorem. Probabilistic semantics only: these declarations do not certify native runtime.

results.title: Schöning randomized k-SAT success bound
results.scope: Satisfiable CNF over a finite variable type, width at most k ≥ 3, uniform start and 3n local-search steps. Lower bound ((k-1)/k)^(k-3) · (k/(2(k-1)))^n / (3n+1). Explicit factors are this formalization’s constants; no native runtime assertion.

results.title: Williams split-and-list transfer from OV to SAT
results.scope: An OV decider of time N^(2-ε) times a polynomial in dimension yields native SAT time of exponent 1 - min(ε,1)/2 in occurring variables, with polynomial encoded-input overhead. This records the transfer, not the separate conditional OVH result or logarithmic-dimension OVH.

results.title: Native algorithmic consequence of sparsification
results.scope: For fixed width k and ε > 0, some natural c transfers a k-SAT decider of clause-count exponent δ ≥ 0 to variable-count exponent ε + cδ. Native machines, encCNF and polynomial encoded-length overhead; no new sharp sparsification constant.
